clips.title: The story
paras: Waters of Xavian is a Horde mage quest offered by Deino in Orgrimmar. Seeking to plumb ancient elven secrets, she tasks her apprentice with traveling to the ruins of Xavian in Ashenvale to draw a sample from its highest waterfall.

Within the dark crevices of the Valley of Spirits, the troll mage Deino seeks out lingering reservoirs of primal arcane energy across Kalimdor. Her gaze turns to Xavian, an ancient night elf city hidden deep in the eastern canopy of Ashenvale. Legends among scholars whisper that the city was steeped in magical knowledge before the Sundering, and its waters are said to retain potent arcane properties that modern casters yearn to dissect.

Reaching the source of these waters is no simple errand. Xavian no longer belongs to peaceful elven sages; it has fallen into ruin and is now overrun by feral, corrupt satyrs who fiercely guard their territory from outsiders. Prying mages must navigate past Satyrnaar and tread through dangerous waterways, avoiding both prowling beasts and demonic sentinels to fill Deino's flask at the base of the city's towering waterfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The fabled city of Xavian lies nestled deep within eastern Ashenvale, and tales of its ancient knowledge are well known among the learned. It is said that the waters of Xavian hold vast magical powers.
I would have a sample of those waters, from their source.

Take this flask and go to Xavian. Gather water from the bottom of its highest waterfall, and return to me. And use care as you move through that ancient city--satyrs now hold the ruins and do not like mages prying into their affairs.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I am pleased you have returned with your skin intact, friend. Do you have the water sample? I am eager to study its properties.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, very good. I trust the satyrs of Xavian gave you little trouble?
Thank you, friend. I will study this sample of Xavian water immediately.
